mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_comments ac INNER JOIN articles a ON a.id = ac.article_id AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED' WHERE ac.article_id = #{articleId} AND ac.deleted = 0 AND ac.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND ac.parent_id IS NULL

SELECT ac.id, ac.article_id AS articleId, ac.parent_id AS parentId, ac.root_id AS rootId, ac.author_id AS authorId, u.display_name AS authorDisplayName, u.avatar_url AS authorAvatarUrl, u.avatar_object_key AS authorAvatarObjectKey, ac.reply_to_user_id AS replyToUserId, ru.display_name AS replyToDisplayName, ac.content, ac.like_count AS likeCount, ac.reply_count AS replyCount, ac.status, (ac.deleted = 1) AS deleted, ac.deleted_by_type AS deletedByType, ac.deleted_by_id AS deletedById, ac.deleted_by_name AS deletedByName, ac.deleted_reason AS deletedReason, ac.deleted_at AS deletedAt,
CASE WHEN acl.id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS likedByCurrentUser,
FALSE AS likedByCurrentUser,
ac.created_at AS createdAt, ac.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM article_comments ac INNER JOIN articles a ON a.id = ac.article_id AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED' LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = ac.author_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users ru ON ru.id = ac.reply_to_user_id AND ru.deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN article_comment_likes acl ON acl.comment_id = ac.id AND acl.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND acl.deleted = 0
WHERE ac.article_id = #{articleId} AND ac.deleted = 0 AND ac.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND ac.parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY ac.created_at DESC, ac.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
